description: Deterministic SVG diagrams from a semantic spec (nCharts), plus a hybrid surface. The caller describes meaning — nodes, edges, grouping, emphasis — and the renderer computes every coordinate: no x/y/width is accepted, so the output cannot overlap or drift. chart_render writes a self-contained SVG (light AND dark in one file) with a .json sidecar holding the exact spec and a preview raster. chart_hybrid restyles the drawing with an image model (local krea2 first, cloud on refusal) while keeping the words as vector type, because diffusion generates glyph-shaped marks rather than preserving text. Ships the authoring contract as a tool so a caller can learn the spec instead of guessing it.

tools.name: chart_guide
tools.description: Read the nCharts spec contract — the authoritative field list, the layout types, the colour rules and the things that are rejected. Call this before authoring a spec: the format is not guessable. Pass `example` to get one complete working spec instead of the contract (call with no arguments first if you want to see the names).

example.description: Name of a bundled example spec to return verbatim (e.g. 'flow-gateway', 'table-comparison', 'steps-ramp'). Omit to get the contract plus the list of available example names.

tools.name: chart_render
tools.description: Render a diagram spec to SVG in MCP storage. Validates and audits first: a spec that would overlap, leave the canvas or overflow its text fails with the offending field named, and nothing is written. Successful renders return the storage paths (svg, spec sidecar, preview) plus audit warnings that mean 'legible but not perfect' — read them, they are the difference between a good diagram and a merely valid one. Pass specPath to re-render an earlier spec after editing it. With text:false it writes the textless geometry base for chart_hybrid instead.

spec.description: The diagram spec as an object. Required unless specPath is given. See chart_guide.

specPath.description: Storage path of an earlier spec sidecar (charts/<base>.json). Loaded and rendered; `spec` wins if both are given.

name.description: Optional slug for the file base name. Defaults to the spec title, else 'chart'.

theme.description: Theme for the preview raster only. The SVG itself always carries both themes. Defaults to dark.

text.description: Set false to write the textless geometry base (no type, weighted strokes, page colour) — the handoff chart_hybrid uses. The spec sidecar is still written so the text layer can be re-rendered. Defaults to true.

strength.description: Stroke weight for the textless base, in canvas units. Defaults to 2.5 for nCharts documents.

preview.description: Render a preview raster (webp) alongside the SVG. Default true; set false when only the vector is wanted.

tools.name: chart_hybrid
tools.description: Restyle a diagram's shapes with an image model while keeping its words as vector type — a hand-drawn (or otherwise prompted) surface with exact, selectable text on top. Takes a spec, a spec sidecar, an SVG string, or a storage svgPath; the SVG's <text> elements are lifted, the drawing is rasterized, restyled through the image-model chain (local krea2 first, cloud only when the local worker refuses), and the type is composited back over a WebP backdrop with the label chips re-plated in the paper colour. Returns the hybrid SVG, the backdrop, the base, a JSON sidecar and an inline PNG preview the calling model can look at. Pass backdropPath from an earlier run to re-composite after editing text — no model call, ~200 ms, same surface. Costs nothing on the local model; the cloud fallback is billed per image.

spec.description: Diagram spec to render first (the text layer comes from this render). See chart_guide.

specPath.description: Storage path of an earlier spec sidecar (charts/<base>.json) — the same sidecar chart_render wrote. The text layer is re-rendered from it; `spec` wins if both are given.

svg.description: An SVG document as a string. Must contain <text> elements — that is the layer that survives.

svgPath.description: Storage path to an SVG (e.g. charts/<base>.svg). A chart_render textless base has no text and is refused.

name.description: Optional slug for the file base name. Defaults to the spec title, else 'hybrid'.

preset.description: Style preset from agents.chart.presets (e.g. 'handdrawn'). Defaults to agents.chart.defaultPreset.

prompt.description: Custom restyle prompt, overriding the preset's wording. Denoise still comes from the preset unless given.

denoise.description: How far the model may depart from the geometry. 0.35-0.5 holds the boxes where the type expects them; 0.75 moves them out from under it. Default from the preset (0.45).

steps.description: Sampler steps for the local krea2 model. Default 20.

theme.description: Palette the vector type is pinned to. A backdrop is one fixed image, so a hybrid is single-theme. Defaults to light.

strength.description: Stroke weight in the rasterized base. Defaults to 2.5 for nCharts documents; omit to leave other SVGs as authored.

preview.description: Rasterize the finished hybrid to PNG for inline display (WebP on disk). Default true.

check.description: After composing, run a vision pass over the raster and return its verdict as text — colour present, labels fitting, defects. Costs a few seconds, and worth it: a model cannot confirm what it did not look at. Default true; set false to skip.

backdropPath.description: Re-composite instead of generating: a stored backdrop (charts/<base>-backdrop.png) from an earlier run. Skips the image model entirely — ~200 ms — so text edits do not cost a generation or change the surface. The drift audit still runs.
